examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Label + internal input + helper text, no side slots filled.

examples.name: WithSlots
examples.summary: `#left` and `#right` slots forwarded to the underlying `InputGroup`.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid state — helper switches to `kind="invalid"` (danger tokens) and the InputGroup border turns danger.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled state — helper falls back to "This field is locked." with the lock icon (`kind="disabled"`), the InputGroup surface goes muted, and cursor becomes `not-allowed`.

examples.name: Icons
examples.summary: PrimeIcons flanking the internal input inside `InputGroup`'s side slots. Same vocabulary as `FieldText`'s Icons story.
